{{Top|leg}}
'''Data-codes''' were used to restrict access to sections aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. The [[Damarind Fishing Station]] used data-codes to prevent unauthorized access to [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca stones]]. However, for the right price forged data-codes could be obtained.
